purpose: Primary-source research ledger for V10 evaluation mechanisms. These sources inform benchmark methodology; none is evidence that NUI itself improves UI generation, and none receives global design authority.

sources.title: WebCoderBench: Benchmarking Web Application Generation with Comprehensive and Interpretable Evaluation Metrics
inspected_mechanisms: fine-grained multi-perspective metric vector
combination of rule-based and LLM-as-judge evaluation
human-preference-aligned interpretation
cross-model metric breakdown rather than one dominant-score narrative
sources.transfer_boundary: V10 transfers the principle of interpretable multi-dimensional evaluation and cross-model breakdown. It does not copy WebCoderBench requirements, proprietary evaluation prompts, weights, or treat its overall score as a NUI metric.
contraindications: Human-preference weighting can hide hard product/safety regressions if treated as compensatory
Metrics optimized for general web generation do not directly validate NUI-specific product-scope or skill-ablation hypotheses
sources.drift_posture: stable-paper; implementation assets may evolve separately
v10_uses: prohibition on one universal NUI score

sources.title: ArtifactsBench: Bridging the Visual-Interactive Gap in LLM Code Generation Evaluation
inspected_mechanisms: programmatic rendering before evaluation
temporal screenshot evidence for dynamic behavior
fine-grained per-task checklist guidance
automated ranking validation against human preference
sources.transfer_boundary: V10 transfers render-first evidence, temporal observation and task-specific rubric discipline. It does not reuse ArtifactsBench task content, its judge prompt, ranking calibration, or infer that the same judge agreement applies to NUI tasks.
contraindications: MLLM-as-judge remains model-dependent and can share correlated visual biases
Temporal screenshots cannot by themselves prove keyboard, accessibility-tree or backend correctness
Human-agreement figures from ArtifactsBench cannot be imported as NUI judge reliability
sources.drift_posture: stable-paper; open-source harness is an implementation reference that must be pinned before code reuse

sources.title: Vision2Web: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Visual Website Development with Agent Verification
inspected_mechanisms: separate evaluation levels for static UI, interactive multi-page frontend and long-horizon full-stack work
GUI-agent verifier combined with VLM-based judge
workflow-oriented functional verification
sources.transfer_boundary: V10 transfers hierarchical separation of artifact difficulty and the principle of combining executable interaction evidence with visual judgment. It does not copy Vision2Web website prototypes, tasks, test cases or evaluator internals.
contraindications: Website reproduction hierarchy does not directly measure open-ended product discovery
GUI agent success can miss semantic or safety quality when the tested workflow is underspecified
A VLM visual judge is not authority for product scope
sources.drift_posture: new-paper; methodology stable enough to cite, code/assets should be version-pinned if adopted

sources.title: WebGen-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Generating Interactive and Functional Websites from Scratch
inspected_mechanisms: multi-file website generation from open instructions
operation-plus-expected-result functional test cases
web-navigation agent executes tests for reproducibility
manual filtering and adjustment of generated functional checks
sources.transfer_boundary: V10 transfers executable operation/expected-result thinking into functionality and workflow dimensions. It does not copy the 647 WebGen-Bench test cases or assume an automated navigation agent covers visual or product-quality judgments.
contraindications: Passing operation tests does not prove visual quality or capability adequacy
Test generation from the same specification can inherit omissions in that specification
Agent navigation errors must be distinguished from product implementation errors
sources.drift_posture: stable-paper; runner implementations are high-drift and must be pinned before reuse

sources.title: Design2Code: Benchmarking Multimodal Code Generation for Automated Front-End Engineering
inspected_mechanisms: curated real-world webpage reference set
automatic visual evaluation metrics
human evaluation used to validate model ranking
fine-grained analysis of visual-element recall and layout correctness
sources.transfer_boundary: V10 transfers the separation between automatic evidence and human-perceived validation, plus the need to inspect layout and element-level failure rather than trust one similarity score. It does not copy Design2Code screenshots or benchmark webpages.
contraindications: Screenshot similarity is not product completeness
Reference reproduction tasks reward fidelity rather than original art direction
Human ranking on reproduction does not establish universal aesthetic taste

sources.title: AutoGUI-v2: A Comprehensive Multi-Modal GUI Functionality Understanding Benchmark
inspected_mechanisms: multi-platform GUI functional-region decomposition
element and region semantics
dynamic state and interaction-outcome prediction
evaluation of uncommon action logic rather than only element grounding
sources.transfer_boundary: V10 uses the insight that GUI evaluation should reason about state consequences, not only visual element presence. It does not import AutoGUI-v2 tasks or treat functionality-captioning scores as UI design quality.
contraindications: Understanding an existing GUI is different from designing a new product
State prediction does not establish product-scope adequacy or visual refinement
sources.drift_posture: new-paper; verify current release artifacts before implementation reuse
